.. Core Concepts of Linear Algebra Linear algebra is a branch of mathematics that studies vectors, matrices, and linear transformations. It provides a systematic way to describe and analyze systems of linear equations. .. Fundamental Components Vector: A mathematical object that can represent quantities such as position, velocity, or features of a data point. Matrix: A collection of numbers arranged in rows and columns, often used to model transformations or relationships between variables. .. Applications • Vectors represent: ◦ Position ◦ Velocity ◦ Features of a data point • Matrices represent: ◦ Transformations ◦ Relationships between variables ◦ Collections of numerical data organized in rows and columns
